title: Chemistry Unit Test II — Atoms & Nucleons
subject: Chemistry

questions.prompt: Fill in the blanks: (a) ______ are positively charged sub-atomic particles in the nucleus. (b) The ______ of an element equals the number of protons in its nucleus. (c) ______ are electrically neutral sub-atomic particles in the nucleus. (d) Protons and neutrons together are known as ______. (e) A negatively charged ion is called a/an ______.
questions.subject: chemistry
questions.modelAnswer: (a) Protons  (b) Atomic number  (c) Neutrons  (d) Nucleons  (e) Anion

questions.prompt: Write two main features of Rutherford's atomic model.
questions.subject: chemistry
questions.modelAnswer: 1. Most of the atom is empty space with a small dense positively-charged nucleus at its centre. 2. Electrons revolve around the nucleus in circular orbits.

rubric.concept: Nucleus is small, dense, positively charged & holds most of the mass
Electrons revolve around the nucleus in orbits

questions.prompt: An atom has atomic number 4 and 5 neutrons. Find its mass number, name of the atom and write its symbol in standard notation.
questions.subject: chemistry
questions.modelAnswer: A = Z + n = 4 + 5 = 9. Name: Beryllium. Symbol: ⁹₄Be.

questions.prompt: Define isotopes. Give three isotopes of hydrogen using correct notation.
questions.subject: chemistry
questions.modelAnswer: Isotopes are atoms of the same element (same Z) with different mass numbers (different neutrons). Hydrogen isotopes: ¹₁H (protium), ²₁H (deuterium), ³₁H (tritium).

rubric.concept: Correct definition (same atomic number, different mass numbers/neutrons)

questions.prompt: For (i) ₁₃Al²⁷ and (ii) ₁₇Cl³⁵: draw the Bohr diagram, state A and Z, find neutrons and protons, and write the electronic configuration.
questions.subject: chemistry
questions.modelAnswer: Al: A=27, Z=13, protons=13, neutrons=14, e-config 2,8,3. Cl: A=35, Z=17, protons=17, neutrons=18, e-config 2,8,7. Both diagrams show nucleus labelled with p,n and shells K,L,M with electron counts.

rubric.concept: Al: A=27, Z=13, p=13, n=14 correct
Al: Bohr diagram with labelled nucleus & shells
Cl: A=35, Z=17, p=17, n=18 correct
Cl: Bohr diagram with labelled nucleus & shells
